book.surrogate.guide.title: Habitat Field Manual
book.surrogate.guide.author: Surrogate Systems
book.surrogate.guide.page1:
HABITAT FIELD MANUAL

The air outside will kill you in about a minute. This pod is sealed. Keep it that way.

The Life Support Unit on the north wall scrubs the air. Its light is green when the room is airtight, red when it is not, dark when it has no power.
book.surrogate.guide.page2:
THE AIRLOCK

Two doors, one chamber. Never open both. Doors close on their own after a few seconds.

Opening a single door to the outside vents the pod: the air goes bad in about ten seconds and takes half a minute to recover.
book.surrogate.guide.page3:
YOUR CHASSIS

Deploy the Robot Chassis inside. Key the Uplink Card on it, then on the Dive Chair. Sit in the chair to dive.

The chassis does not breathe. It goes outside. You do not.

The Charging Dock parks and charges it. The Solar Collectors on the roof feed the dock and life support.
book.surrogate.guide.page4:
TOOLS

The Mining Drill and Arc Cutter only work coupled to a chassis, and they draw its power.

The Atmosphere Scanner tells you if a room is sealed, and points at the leak if it is not. Sneak-use it on a block to ask if that block is airtight.
book.surrogate.guide.page5:
BUILDING

Any full block is airtight: stone, planks, glass, hull plating. Ordinary doors, slabs, stairs and fences are not.

To expand: build the new room against the pod, seal it, then knock through the shared wall. Do the outside work with the chassis.
book.surrogate.guide.page6:
THE WASTES

Sulfur crust makes life support units and gunpowder. Scrap heaps hold iron. Dead groves have petrified wood.

Watch your fatigue. Sleep resets it. Watch your body readout while diving: if the pod breaches, come home.
book.surrogate.guide.page7:
DECONTAMINATION

The chassis picks up grime outside. The shower in the airlock ceiling hoses it down and holds the inner door until it is clean.

Caustic sand, ash and sulfur set off the alarm. Leave them outside, or in a chest, never loose in the base.
book.surrogate.guide.page8:
THE RADIO

You are not alone. Keep the field radio in your pack, or listen through the chassis. Use it to get a bearing on each signal.

They each need something. Bring it, and they will make it worth the trip.

survivor.surrogate.okafor.name: Dr. Ada Okafor
survivor.surrogate.okafor.radio.1: This is Okafor at Greenhouse Station. Scrubber is down to its last cell. If anyone is out there, I am not going anywhere.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.radio.2: Okafor again. The tomatoes are fine. I am less fine. Two power cells would keep this room breathing another month.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.radio.3: Greenhouse Station, still transmitting. I can hear a chassis on the dunes some days. I keep waving at the window.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.greet: Over here! Do not open that door with dirt on you, I only have the one room.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.plea: My scrubber needs power. %s %s would do it. I can pay in parts: I have a fabricator module I will never use.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.thanks: You beautiful machine. Take the fabricator module. Fit it to your chassis and it will craft anything a bench can.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.idle.1: The air in here has not been this clean in months. Come by any time.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.idle.2: I am drying seeds for you. Next time.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.rescued_radio: Greenhouse Station to all stations: scrubber is back up. Somebody out there has a good heart and a better robot.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.safe: Okafor here. Sky is the colour of old brass again this morning. Take care of that chassis.
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.name: Mikkel Sorensen
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.radio.1: Mayday, mayday. Survey rover Two is down, I am holed up in the pod. The rover is scrap unless I get repair kits.
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.radio.2: Sorensen, Survey Two. Still here. The pod is holding. The rover is not. Two repair kits and I could get her hull back.
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.radio.3: If anyone copies, I have a spare cargo bay module in the pod. It is yours for a couple of repair kits.
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.greet: You made it! Mind the doorway, I have not swept.
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.plea: The rover is in pieces. Bring me %s %s and the cargo bay module on that shelf is yours.
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.thanks: That is more than enough. The cargo bay bolts on to any chassis. Nine more slots. Do not fill them with sand.
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.idle.1: Rover Two will drive again. Give me a week.
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.idle.2: Salt pans to the west are flat as a table. Good driving, if you like flat.
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.rescued_radi: Survey Two to all stations: repairs under way. Whoever you are, I owe you a drink and a drive.
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.safe: Sorensen here. Rover Two is running. Badly, but running.
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.name: Yuki Tanaka
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.radio.1: Sulfur Works calling. The scrubber cartridges are spent and the vents outside are the only sulfur I cannot reach.
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.radio.2: Tanaka, Sulfur Works. Eight sulfur and I can rebuild the cartridges. I would go myself if the door did not kill me.
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.radio.3: Sulfur Works, still on the air. There is a battery expansion here nobody will ever use. Trade?
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.greet: A chassis! Tell me you have sulfur on you. Actually, tell me at the door, not in here.
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.plea: I need %s %s to rebuild the scrubber cartridges. The battery expansion is yours for it.
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.thanks: Perfect. Take the battery expansion. Twice the charge, twice the range. Now get that sulfur out of my airlock.
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.idle.1: Cartridges are curing. Another day and this room will smell like nothing at all.
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.idle.2: Do not build with sulfur crust. I learned that the hard way.
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.rescued_radio: Sulfur Works to all stations: cartridges rebuilt. To the chassis that brought the sulfur: thank you.
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.safe: Tanaka here. The vents are loud tonight. Sleep well, everyone.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.name: Old Brandt
survivor.surrogate.brandt.radio.1: This is Brandt. I am not asking for rescue. I am asking for bread. Eight loaves and I will stop transmitting.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.radio.2: Brandt again. Been out here longer than your station has existed. Potatoes gave out. Bread, if you have it.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.radio.3: Brandt. Still hungry. I have reinforced plating I pulled off a dead rover. Bread for plating. Fair trade.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.greet: Huh. A tin can. Well, come in then, if you are clean.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.plea: %s %s. That is the deal. The plating is by the door.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.thanks: That will do. Reinforced plating, as promised. Bolt it on before you go anywhere stupid.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.idle.1: Bread was good. You can go now.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.idle.2: The grove east of here has the only real wood for a hundred blocks. Do not tell anyone.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.rescued_radio: Brandt. Fed. Signing off. If you find my rover, it is yours.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.safe: Brandt here. Nothing to report. Which is how I like it.
crew.surrogate.halloran.name: Ines Halloran
crew.surrogate.marsh.name: Teo Marsh
crew.surrogate.halloran.epitaph: Ines Halloran. Station lead, Site Two.
crew.surrogate.marsh.epitaph: Teo Marsh. Company representative. He fixed things.
crew.surrogate.halloran.busy: You walked. Good. Sit down; there is no second chair, so sit on the chest.
crew.surrogate.marsh.busy: Do not look at me. I only fix things.
cinematic.surrogate.title: SURROGATE
book.surrogate.log.title: Station Log, Site Two
book.surrogate.log.author: I. Halloran
book.surrogate.log.page1:
Day 208.

New pilot due on the next drop. Marsh has cleared the bunk. I have cleared the schedule. Neither of us has cleared the vent.

The annex floor is warm again.
book.surrogate.log.page2:
Day 211.

Marsh says the pressure wobble on the annex scrubber is the vent breathing under the slab. He wants to dig it out. I want to move the annex.

We will do neither until the new pilot is up and driving.
book.surrogate.log.page3:
Day 212.

Drop confirmed for tomorrow. The company has moved the landing to Site Four. Six hundred metres. Nobody asked us.

Rule one for the new one: never both doors. Rule two: the body stays home. Rule three they can have when they have earned it.

crew.surrogate.castellanos.epitaph: Mags Castellanos. She flew forty-one of these.
crew.surrogate.ferreira.name: Dr. Nadia Ferreira
crew.surrogate.ferreira.epitaph: Nadia Ferreira. She logged it. Nobody read the log.
crew.surrogate.teague.name: Bram Teague
crew.surrogate.teague.epitaph: Bram Teague. He talked to the ship, and it listened.
crew.surrogate.sleeper.name: Sleeper
crew.surrogate.sleeper.busy: %s does not answer. The chair hums.
crew.surrogate.sleeper.epitaph: %s. Third rotation. Six hundred and eleven days. Nine hundred kilometres from home.
message.surrogate.transit.not_yet: Not yet. There is a day to get through first.
message.surrogate.transit.patch_kit: Teague hands you a rebreather and four hull plates. Use a plate on the torn section to seal it.
book.surrogate.captain.title: Transit Log, SSV Provender
book.surrogate.captain.author: M. Castellanos
book.surrogate.captain.page1:
Run 41.

Transfer station to Sallow, six days after the boost. Twelve pilots in the hold, one thawed in the med bay for Habitat Seven, freight for Nine.

Teague says the aft seam is weeping again. Logged. Again.
book.surrogate.captain.page2:
Day 38.

Seven is running hot. Ferreira wants him woken. The contract says transit is billable while the link is up, and the company reads the contract, not the log.

I have flown forty of these. I know how this one ends.
book.surrogate.captain.page3:
Day 40.

The new one thaws tomorrow. Halloran asked for someone quiet. I told her the hold is full of quiet people.

There is a lever by the rack that fixes nothing. I let Teague keep it. People need a lever.
book.surrogate.port.title: Neural Port: Patient Information
book.surrogate.port.author: Surrogate Systems
book.surrogate.port.page1:
YOUR NEURAL PORT

The port is fitted behind the left ear under local anaesthetic. Most pilots report no discomfort. Some report a sense of distance. This is normal.

Do not remove the port.
book.surrogate.port.page2:
WHAT TO EXPECT

While linked, your body remains in the dive chair. It will be hungry when you return. It may be tired. It is still yours.

Dreams of walking are common in the first month.
book.surrogate.port.page3:
YOUR BODY STAYS HOME

Surrogate pilots enjoy the safest working conditions in the frontier program. Injuries to the chassis are not injuries to you.

Return passage is provided at the end of your rotation.

book.surrogate.descent.title: Descent Protocol
book.surrogate.descent.author: Surrogate Systems
book.surrogate.descent.page1:
DESCENT

The drop pod is automated. The passenger is sedated for the descent and wakes at the habitat.

You will not feel the landing. This is by design.
book.surrogate.descent.page2:
ON ARRIVAL

The station lead will brief you. Deploy your chassis inside the pod. Never open both airlock doors.

Your body stays home. Your work goes further.
book.surrogate.contract.title: Contract 7-1188
book.surrogate.contract.author: Surrogate Systems
book.surrogate.contract.page1:
SURROGATE PILOT, HABITAT SEVEN

Rotation: 90 days.
Extension: at the discretion of the company.
Transit: billable while linked.

Return passage: see clause 14.
book.surrogate.contract.page2:
CLAUSE 14

Return passage is provided on the first available upbound freight following the end of the final rotation.

There is no upbound freight schedule at this time.
tooltip.surrogate.rebreather: %s seconds of your own air. Use it before you need it.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.thaw1: Pulse is fine. Eyes. Open them. There you are.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.thaw2: Ferreira. Flight medical. You are on the Provender, forty-one days out of the transfer station and six from Sallow.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.thaw3: You slept through the boost. Everything you feel right now is normal, including the part where you want to be sick.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.thaw4: Stand up when the room stops moving. The captain wants a look at you.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.bridge_nudge: Forward is the end with the window, pilot.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.bridge1: Castellanos. I fly this thing. Come and look at the window.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.bridge2: That light. Do not let the size fool you. That is Sallow. Six days and it fills that window. Then you go down, and I go home.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.bridge3: Your body gets a chair down there and never leaves it. The chassis does the walking. The company calls it the safest job in the system.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.bridge4: The company is not on this ship.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.bridge5: Galley is port side, midships. Eat. The bunk with your name on it is yours. Tomorrow the doctor puts a port in your head.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.eat_nudge: Eat. I did not thaw you out to watch you faint.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.rest_nudge: Lights go down at twenty hundred. Take the hint.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.rest_forced: You are asleep on your feet. Hold still.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.port_call: Med bay when you are up. Do not eat first.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.medbay_nudge: Med bay. Starboard, by the bunks. Today, please.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.port1: Sit. This takes a minute and it feels like a year. I am going to talk the whole time so you have something to hold on to.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.port2: The port goes in behind the ear. It does not hurt. That is the part I would worry about.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.port3: We test it on the calibration unit in the hold. You will see the hold through its lens. Do not try to stand up. You are not in there.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.link1: Open your eyes. Not those ones.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.link2: Good. Look around. That is the hold. Those are the other passengers. Do not worry about them yet.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.link3: Pan left. Right. Now walk. Slowly. It is your body that thinks it is walking. The unit just agrees.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.bleed1: ...Provender, Habitat Seven, you are bleeding onto our band. Who is this? Chief, someone is on our...
cinematic.surrogate.transit.port4: That was Habitat Seven. Your people. The relay was not supposed to be open.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.port5: Congratulations. You have a port. Eat something. Sleep. The rest of the week is in your hands, which is more than most people get.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.relay_warn: Whoever is on the relay, get off it. It is not ours to use.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.rest2_nudge: Sleep. The port settles better when you are not staring at a wall.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.hold_nudge: Aft. Through the door that says keep sealed. Come on.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.hold1: Twelve pilots. Chairs are cheaper than cabins.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.hold2: They were down on Sallow before you woke up. They will be working while you sleep. Transit is billable if the link is up, so the link is up.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.hold3: Coolant to the rack is dropping. Junction is aft, port side. Close the bypass. Lever. Down.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.coolant_nudg: The lever. Aft wall, under the sign. Down is closed.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.coolant_done: Pressure is back. See, you are useful.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.alarm1: Seven. Seven is alarming. Doctor! Seven!
cinematic.surrogate.transit.alarm2: Vasquez. His numbers have been bad since Tuesday. I logged it. Nobody reads the log.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.alarm4: He is nine hundred kilometres from his own body, Bram. Pull the link and he wakes up in a chassis that is not there.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.alarm7: Time of death, transit day forty-three. Third rotation. Six hundred and eleven days.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.alarm8: Log it. The company will want the chassis recovered at Habitat Nine. They will bill the estate.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.alarm9: They did not even notice. The other eleven. They are still walking around down there.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.rest3_nudge: Sleep. That is an instruction, not advice.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.turn_call: Turnover at oh nine hundred. Everyone forward. Anything not bolted down goes in a locker, including you.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.turn_nudge: Bridge, pilot. I am not doing this twice.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.turn1: Halfway. We flip the ship and burn the other way, or we arrive at Sallow at eleven kilometres a second, which is not arriving.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.turn2: Main engine off in ten. Hold on to something that is not the doctor.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.turn4: Enjoy it. This is the only holiday you get.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.turn5: Port side. Look. The whole sky goes past.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.turn6: Engine in ten. Feet on the floor.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.breach1: Seam let go. Aft hold, starboard, frame twelve. She is venting.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.breach3: I need hands. Pilot. Rebreather and plating, they are in your pockets. With me.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.patch_nudge: Rebreather first. Then take a plate to the torn section on the starboard wall and use it on the frame. It is the one with the stars in it.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.patch_done: Sealed. Scrubber will have it breathable in a minute. Stay put until it is.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.patch_timeou: Forget it. Give me the plate.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.breach4: The chairs are sealed. They are the only thing on this ship that is.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.breach5: Hold is holding. Everyone breathe. Halloran is on the relay, and she does not like being kept waiting.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.relay1: Provender, Habitat Seven. Halloran. Marsh says you fell into our band on Tuesday. Welcome aboard. Do not do it again.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.relay2: Bring tomato seeds. The company will not ship them. Ask Castellanos, she owes me.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.relay4: Two hundred and eight days here. Chair is keyed, chest is packed. Come down in one piece and we will teach you the rest.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.sallow_call: Aft windows, if you want to see where you are going.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.window_nudge: The hold. Aft wall. It is hard to miss now.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.sallow1: Ash Dunes, the grey band. Acid Flats, the green. The bright line is the Salt Pans.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.sallow2: Habitat Seven is past the terminator. It is morning there. Halloran will be walking.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.sallow3: Two hundred and eight days. Her rotation was ninety.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.sallow4: Nobody comes back up, pilot. Bodies do not ship well. I fly the meat down and the freight up. That is the run.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.sallow5: I am telling you because somebody told me, and I was angry for a year, and then I was flying.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.descent_brie: Descent protocol is on the lectern in the med bay. Sedation is standard for the drop. You will not feel the landing.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.relay5: Marsh here. The annex floor is warm again. Chief says it is fine. Chief says a lot of things. Bring the seeds.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.contract1: Your contract. Surrogate pilot, Habitat Seven. Return passage dated four years from Tuesday.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.contract2: There has never been a return passage. I have flown forty-one of these.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.contract3: I can log you unfit. Ferreira signs it, you ride back up with the freight, you never see Sallow. Say yes and it is done.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.system1: Contract 7-1188. Descent scheduled. Medical hold denied.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.contract5: They heard me. They always hear me.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.contract6: Come on. There is a check I need to run.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.port_check2: The port does that. It stops when you have something else to dream about.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.relay6: Provender, Halloran. Rule one for the new one: never both doors. Rule two: the body stays home. Everything else you can learn the slow way.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.relay7: Halloran out. See you in the morning.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.drop_nudge: Through the hold, hatch on the starboard side. We are waiting.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.drop1: Sit. This is the part you do not remember.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.drop2: Halloran is a friend of mine. Tell her Mags says she still owes me a drive.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.pod_nudge: The seat, pilot. It is not going to get easier.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.drop4: Deep breath. Count back from ten for me.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.system2: Descent in ten. Hatch sealed. Sedation administered.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.drop6: Provender to pilot. Good luck down there. Nobody says that. I am saying it.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.objective.ea: Eat something from the galley, port side
cinematic.surrogate.transit.objective.li: Hold still while the port calibrates
cinematic.surrogate.transit.objective.ho: Follow Teague aft to the cargo hold
cinematic.surrogate.transit.objective.co: Close the coolant bypass: the lever on the aft rack
cinematic.surrogate.transit.objective.tu: Go forward to the bridge for turnover
cinematic.surrogate.transit.objective.pa: Use the rebreather, then use a hull plate on the torn plating in the hold, starboard side
cinematic.surrogate.transit.objective.wi: Look at Sallow from the aft window of the hold
cinematic.surrogate.transit.objective.dr: Report to the drop bay, through the hold
cinematic.surrogate.transit.objective.po: Take the seat in the drop pod
cinematic.surrogate.transit.thaw5: The cat is Ballast. She is not cargo, whatever the manifest says. Do not feed her from the galley.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.drop2b: Take the cat. She hates the drop and she hates me, so you two will get on.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.galley1: Galley unit is not a toy. Whatever is in there, take it out.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.galley2: I can hear it from engineering. That is a casserole. It has been in there since the transfer station.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.galley4: That was the casserole. Nobody touch the galley unit. Nobody touch anything.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.alarm_button: Pilot. That is the general alarm. Take your hand off it.
Every time you press that, the scrubbers cycle. Stop pressing it.
Ferreira. Log the new one as a hazard.
message.surrogate.breach_needs_plate: The plate is gone. Use a hull plate on the frame to seal it.
title.surrogate.name: SURROGATE
terminal.surrogate.keys: UP/DOWN or click: files.  ESC: log off.
terminal.surrogate.status.breach: HULL BREACH: cargo hold, starboard. Seal it.
terminal.surrogate.status.footer: Session logged. Surrogate Systems accepts no liability for anything read on this unit.
terminal.surrogate.bridge.name: BRIDGE
terminal.surrogate.bridge.1.title: COURSE
terminal.surrogate.bridge.1.body:
# ROUTE 41: TRANSFER STATION TO SALLOW
Seven days under thrust. Turnover on day four, main engine off for the flip, back on for the braking burn.

Arrival window: day seven, 0600 ship time. Drop pod release once the hold is depressurised and the passengers are logged.

# RETURN
The Provender does not land. She drops the pod, takes on the empty chairs from run 40, and burns for home.
terminal.surrogate.bridge.2.title: CAPTAIN LOG 41-03
terminal.surrogate.bridge.2.body:
Twelve chairs in the hold, twelve pilots in them, all reading green except seven. Seven reads green too, just not in a way I like. Ferreira says the port is fine and the pilot is dreaming. I have asked her to watch it.

Teague wants the coolant bypass looked at before turnover. He is right and I have told him so, which he enjoyed.

The new one thawed early. Company error, again. We will feed them and put them to work.
terminal.surrogate.bridge.3.title: COMMS SCHEDULE
terminal.surrogate.bridge.3.body:
# RELAY WINDOWS
Day 1: 0900 company relay, 2100 site 04 beacon (ping only).
Day 4: turnover. No comms while the engine is off; the dish is on the engine mount.
Day 6: 1200 company relay, contract confirmation for the passengers.
Day 7: continuous with site 04 from 0400 until the drop.

! Site 04 has not acknowledged a voice call since run 39. Beacon pings are on schedule.
terminal.surrogate.medbay.name: MED BAY
terminal.surrogate.medbay.1.title: THAW PROTOCOL
terminal.surrogate.medbay.1.body:
# COLD SLEEP REVIVAL, STANDARD
1. Warm to 34 degrees over ninety minutes. Do not rush this.
2. Monitor for arrhythmia. Sedate if the patient thrashes.
3. Fluids, then solid food within six hours. The galley is port side, aft of the bunks.
4. Port calibration in the link chair no sooner than day two.

! Early thaw (company scheduling error, form CS-12) skips step 1. Expect headache, confusion and a bad temper. Not the patient at fault.
terminal.surrogate.medbay.2.title: PATIENT 07
terminal.surrogate.medbay.2.body:
# VASQUEZ, R. ROTATION 3. DAY 611 IN CHAIR.
Port telemetry nominal. Neural load steady. Dream state continuous since day 590, which is unusual and which the company manual calls acceptable.

I do not call it acceptable. A pilot that long in the link is not resting; they are somewhere else. I have flagged it twice. Both flags were closed with the note SEE MANUAL.

! If the chair alarms, do not pull the port. Sedate first, then pull. Pulling first is how you get a flatline.
terminal.surrogate.medbay.3.title: FERREIRA, NOTES
terminal.surrogate.medbay.3.body:
The new pilot is fine. Angry, hungry, fine. I like them better than the manual does.

Ballast has been sleeping on the cot again. I have stopped moving her.

Castellanos asked me what happens to a body that never comes back for its pilot. I said the body sleeps. He asked for how long. I did not have an answer he wanted.
terminal.surrogate.hold.name: CARGO HOLD
terminal.surrogate.hold.1.title: MANIFEST 41
terminal.surrogate.hold.1.body:
# PASSENGERS: 12 (billable)
Chairs 01 to 12, port rack odd, starboard rack even. All rotation contracts current.
07: VASQUEZ, R. Rotation 3. Flagged by medical, flag closed.

# FREIGHT
Hull plating, 40 units. Reinforced glass, 12. Power cells, 30. Rebreathers, 6. Life support spares, 2.
One cat (not billable, not cargo, do not list the cat).

# DROP POD
One seat. One pilot. The chairs stay aboard; the pilots do not.
terminal.surrogate.hold.2.title: ENVIRONMENT LOG
terminal.surrogate.hold.2.body:
Hold scrubber, starboard forward. Sealed volume nominal. Pressure holding.

# NOTES
The frame at rib 12 starboard was patched at the transfer station and signed off. The weld looks like it was done in a hurry, because it was.

! If the pressure drops, close the coolant bypass on the aft rack FIRST, then find the hole. The bypass dumps heat into the rack, and the rack is where the passengers are.
terminal.surrogate.hold.3.title: CHAIR FIRMWARE
terminal.surrogate.hold.3.body:
# SURROGATE SYSTEMS DIVE CHAIR, RACK MODEL
Firmware 4.1.2. Link timeout raised to indefinite for transit rotations.

Known issues: the visor boom on early units sits low. Raise it before the pilot goes under, not after.

Do not update the firmware in transit. Do not update the firmware on a chair with a pilot in it. The company has asked us to stop saying this in the notes. Noted.
terminal.surrogate.engineering.name: ENGINEERING
terminal.surrogate.engineering.1.title: FAULT LOG
terminal.surrogate.engineering.1.body:
# OPEN
Coolant bypass, aft rack: valve sticks. Manual lever fitted. Close it before turnover. (Teague)
Galley unit: door interlock removed by a previous crew. It will run with the door open. It will run with anything. (Teague)
Rib 12 starboard weld: watch it under the relight. (Teague)

# CLOSED
Forward scrubber grate, cleaned.
Day lamps in the corridor, rewired. One per day now, so people stop asking what day it is.
terminal.surrogate.engineering.2.title: COOLANT BYPASS
terminal.surrogate.engineering.2.body:
The bypass takes reactor heat past the radiators and into the hold rack when the fins are stowed for the turn. It is meant to be shut once the fins are out again. On this ship it is shut when somebody walks aft and shuts it.

The lever is on the aft bulkhead of the hold, port side, next to the sign that says COOLANT. It is that lever. There is no other lever.
terminal.surrogate.engineering.3.title: HULL SURVEY
terminal.surrogate.engineering.3.body:
# STARBOARD, RIBS 10 TO 14
Plating sound except rib 12, which was replaced at the transfer station. The new plate is thinner than the old one and the weld is cold along the upper edge.

! Under a hard relight this is where the hull goes. The patch locker by the hold door has four plates and a rebreather for exactly that.

To patch: rebreather on, plate in hand, use the plate on the torn section. It will take a plate from anyone. It will not take an argument.
terminal.surrogate.pod.name: DROP BAY
terminal.surrogate.pod.1.title: DESCENT CHECKLIST
terminal.surrogate.pod.1.body:
# BEFORE RELEASE
1. Pilot seated, restraints locked, visor down.
2. Hatch sealed. Bay scrubber to standby.
3. Sedation offered. Sedation is a good idea.
4. Cat secured. (Amended, run 41.)

# AFTER RELEASE
The pod flies itself. Nine minutes of noise, then a bump, then the door. The habitat pod is the door you can see. Go in. Do not open the annex.
terminal.surrogate.pod.2.title: LANDING SITE
terminal.surrogate.pod.2.body:
# SALLOW, SITE 04
One habitat pod, sealed, powered by roof collectors. One crew annex, attached. Landing pad south of the airlock.

Atmosphere: lethal. Sulfur, chlorine, ash. A rebreather buys one minute. A hull breach buys less.

Previous occupant: HALLORAN, contract pilot, rotation 2. Status: on site.
Second occupant: MARSH, company representative. Status: on site.

! Site 04 has not answered a voice call since run 39.
terminal.surrogate.habitat.name: SITE 04
terminal.surrogate.habitat.1.title: SITE SURVEY
terminal.surrogate.habitat.1.body:
# SALLOW, SITE 04
Caustic desert with ash dunes to the north and acid flats to the west. Salt pans south. A dead grove east, which was alive when the survey was made.

Sulfur crust and scrap from earlier runs within two hundred metres. Fumaroles vent to the north; the drill chews through their crust.

! Nothing out there breathes this. You do not either. The chassis does not need to.
terminal.surrogate.habitat.2.title: OCCUPANT LOG
terminal.surrogate.habitat.2.body:
# HALLORAN, ROTATION 2
Day 1: Pod sealed. Scrubber green. The annex chair is mine, the pod chair is for the next one.
Day 18: Marsh arrived on the supply run with a clipboard and no chassis. Says the company wants the numbers.
Day 40: Found the scrap heap south of the pad. Somebody walked out here before us and did not walk back.
Day 55: The annex scrubber coughs at night. Marsh says it is fine. Marsh says everything is fine.
Day 61: Sleeping in the chair. Easier than getting up.
terminal.surrogate.habitat.3.title: COMPANY NOTICE
terminal.surrogate.habitat.3.body:
# SURROGATE SYSTEMS, CONTRACT PILOTS, SALLOW
Your body stays home. Your chassis goes out. Your contract covers the chassis.

Rotations are 90 days. Extensions are voluntary and cannot be refused. Questions about this sentence should be directed to your company representative.

Do not open both airlock doors at once. Do not open the annex door if the annex is not answering. Do not feed the cat from the galley.
terminal.surrogate.personal.name: TERMINAL
terminal.surrogate.personal.1.title: PILOT MANUAL
terminal.surrogate.personal.1.body:
# THE SHORT VERSION
Deploy a chassis from the chest. Key the uplink card on it, then on a dive chair. Sit. You are the chassis now.

The chassis runs on power cells and a dock. It does not heal; repair kits do that. If it is wrecked, the wreck keeps your cargo. Come back for it.

Your body is still in the chair. It gets tired, hungry and poisoned like anyone. Disconnect (pilot menu) to eat and sleep. Keep its room sealed.

The mission log key shows what you are meant to be doing and what everyone has said.
terminal.surrogate.personal.2.title: ABOUT THIS UNIT
terminal.surrogate.personal.2.body:
Surrogate Systems wall terminal, field model. Wired to nothing in particular.

Place one aboard a ship or in a company habitat and it joins that network. Out here it shows you the air, your body, and this page.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.pod1: Descent complete. Habitat Seven, Site Four. Atmosphere: sealed.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.pod2: Occupants: one. Animals: one. Company representative: not present.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.call1: Site Four, Site Two. Halloran. You are down. Say something so I know the pod did not land on you.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.answer_nudg: The field radio. Chest, north wall. Hold it and use it. I can hear the carrier from here.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.answer_time: Fine. The pod says you are breathing. Breathing counts.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.call2: There you are. Ines Halloran, station lead, Site Two. That is Marsh on the other set. He is the company. He fixes things.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.call4: They were meant to drop you here. They dropped you at Four. Six hundred metres of sand between us, and all of it eats boots. Get used to this voice. It is most of what you get of us for a while.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.call5: Rules. Scrubber, north wall. Green lamp, you are breathing. Red, the room is open and you have ten seconds. Dark, no power.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.call6: The airlock. Two doors. Never both. That chamber is the only reason your pod is not a coffin.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.call7: The roof is glass because somebody at the company wanted a farm. Glass is airtight. Please do not test that.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.kit1: Chest. Chassis, card, tools. Deploy the chassis on the floor. Anywhere you like; there is nobody's foot to put it on.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.kit_nudge: The chassis is the item that looks like a chassis. Use it on the floor.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.kit_timeout: Marsh. Does that pod have a cargo arm?
It has a cargo arm. It is not for this.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.key1: Card on the chassis, then on the chair. The chair is yours now. Nobody else's card goes in it.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.key_nudge: The card remembers the chassis. The chair remembers the card. You remember the chair.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.key_timeout: Remote keying. Do not tell the company I know how to do that.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.dive1: Sit. The calibration on the ship does not count. Ten seconds to boot and it feels like a minute. Arms go first. Then it is just you and the lens.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.dive2: First dive is the worst. Second one is also the worst. After that you stop counting.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.dive_timeou: I cannot sit in it for you. When you do, call me. I will be here. I am always here.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.online1: Look at that. Not even a nosebleed.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.online2: Take it out. Inner door. Wait for it to shut. Outer door. And bring it back clean; the shower holds the inner door until it is.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.out_nudge: The airlock. Inner door, wait for it to shut, then the outer door.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.out1: That is the wastes. Caustic sand, sulfur, and a sky that never clears. Everything out there wants to dissolve you. The chassis does not care. That is the whole idea.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.out2: Watch your power. Half an hour on a charge, less if you sprint. When it goes dark, it goes dark where it stands. Home before that.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.out3: Last thing. Your body is in that chair. Whatever happens out there, it is in here. If the BODY line ever says BREACH, you drop everything and you come home.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.night1: Enough for one day. Sleep in the bunk when it is dark; the body in the chair needs it more than the one outside. I call at first light.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.night2: Do not leave the chassis outside. The sand gets into the joints.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.rest_nudge: You can also just wait for the light. I did, my first night. It is not a good night.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.morning1: Up. Look out the airlock. Something for you on the pad.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.look_nudge: Through the airlock, or through the glass if you would rather look than walk.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.morning2: My chassis. I walked it over in the dark. Sand in the joints. Marsh, you were right, and you may have that once.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.morning4: It carried a crate. Plates, a cell, and a book. Read the book inside. It is not company reading.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.assay1: Company representative, reading you the line I have to read. Sallow Assay, Contract Seven. Samples to the crate, numbers to the relay. When the assay is complete, the company sends the ship.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.assay2: He has to say that. Nobody has ever seen the ship.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.assay4: Sulfur seam, south of your pad, past the sign. Drill one lump of crust and put the sulfur in the assay crate by your door. The company gets its first number and leaves us alone for a day.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.sample_nudg: The drill, coupled to the chassis. The crust is the yellow rock. The crate is the box with the sign on it.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.sample_time: Leave it. The company has waited two hundred days for a number. It can wait for you.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.sample_done: Logged. Sample one of forty. Thank you.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.follow1: Walk with me. Mine knows the way to the heap. Yours should learn it.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.out4: Scrap heaps have iron. Somebody walked out here before us and did not walk back.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.colony1: The book in the crate. I want a room where four people can sit at one table without a radio between them. Marsh wants tomatoes. Same room.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.colony2: The company did not ship module two. There is a slab where it should be. That slab is our room.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.colony3: Not today. Today you sleep. Tomorrow Marsh walks.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.walk1: Marsh. Two hours out, on foot, in a suit rated for one. I am coming to fix your dock. Do not open the outer door until I am standing in front of it.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.walk2: He is fine. He complains at that pitch when he is fine.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.marsh_nudge: He comes up from the south. Watch the glass, or the airlock.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.walk3: At your door. Outer door, please. Please is not a company word, so do not repeat it.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.door_nudge: Inner door, wait for it to shut, then come and open the outer one. Never both.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.door_timeou: Right. I am letting myself in. Look away if it bothers you.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.walk4: Chamber. Shower. This is the part I hate.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.meet2: Teo Marsh. Company representative, which means I hold the clipboard. Station fixer, which means I hold everything else.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.meet4: Ines said Castellanos would send a cat. I said nobody sends a cat. Nobody tells me anything.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.dock1: Your dock. They wired it for the ship's bus, not the roof's. It charges at a crawl. Hand me a wrench and I will make it honest.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.wrench_nudg: A wrench. Chest, if you have not moved it. Use it on me; I do not bite.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.wrench_time: I brought my own. I always bring my own.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.dock2: There. Honest. It charges a chassis overnight now instead of over a week.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.seeds1: She asked Castellanos for seeds. Did she...
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.seeds2: She did. Keep them. Hand them to Ines yourself. She will want to see your face when you do.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.seeds3: No. Of course not. Nobody sends seeds.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.colony6: The slab east of you. Module two, not shipped. We have plates at Site Two and you have hands. When the assay lets us breathe, we build the room there. One table. Four chairs.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.leave1: Two hours back. If I am not home by dark she walks, and nobody wants that.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.leave2: ...I left my clipboard on your table. Keep it. Read the forms. Laugh at the forms. They are not funny.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.end1: Site Four, Site Two. He is on the ridge. I can see his lamp. Thank you for the dock, and for the door.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.end2: Rule three. I did not give you rule three. Nobody goes home alone. That includes you.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.end: Three days. Two voices. The room is not built yet.
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.objective.a: Find the field radio in the chest and use it
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.objective.d: Deploy the Robot Chassis from the chest onto the floor
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.objective.b: Key the Uplink Card on the chassis, then use it on the Dive Chair
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.objective.d: Use the Dive Chair to link with your chassis
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.objective.o: Cycle the airlock and drive outside
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.objective.r: Sleep in the bunk, or wait for first light
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.objective.l: See what is on the landing pad
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.objective.s: Drill sulfur crust south of the pad and put sulfur in the assay crate
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.objective.d: Cycle the airlock for Marsh: inner door, wait, then the outer door
cinematic.surrogate.prologue.objective.w: Give Marsh the wrench (use it on him)
crew.surrogate.halloran.radio.later: Site Two. I am on the other set with Marsh. Later.
crew.surrogate.halloran.radio.1: Site Two. Still here. Say what you need.
crew.surrogate.halloran.radio.2: If you are calling about the seeds: yes. I still want them.
crew.surrogate.halloran.radio.3: Marsh says hello. Marsh did not say hello. I am saying it for him.
crew.surrogate.halloran.radio.4: Sky over here is the colour of old brass. Over there too, I expect.
crew.surrogate.halloran.radio.5: Chassis charged? Body fed? Then you are ahead of most pilots I have known.
crew.surrogate.halloran.radio.6: Halloran out. Call when you are on the ridge and I will put the kettle on. There is no kettle.
cinematic.surrogate.transit.drop2c: And these. Seeds. She asked. Do not tell the company, and do not tell her I said yes.
tooltip.surrogate.tomato_seeds: A packet from the Provender's galley. Halloran asked; the company said no.
tooltip.surrogate.tomato_seeds.use: They will not grow in the wastes. They might, somewhere with a roof.
tooltip.surrogate.radio.call: Sneak and use to raise Halloran
book.surrogate.common_room.title: Common Room, draft 3
book.surrogate.common_room.author: I. Halloran
book.surrogate.common_room.page1:
COMMON ROOM. DRAFT THREE.

One room, sealed, on the slab east of Four. Big enough for a table and the people who sit at it.

Not a corridor. Not a chair with a lens. A room.
book.surrogate.common_room.page2:
Walls: hull plates two high, then glass, so the sky is in the room with us. Scrubber on the north wall. One door, an airlock, off the pod.

Marsh gets a bed by the wall and a shelf for his forms. I get the corner.
book.surrogate.common_room.page3:
What it is for:

Sitting down. Eating something warm at the same time as someone else. Arguing with a face instead of a hiss.

When the assay is done and the company is quiet, this is the first thing we build. Draft three. There will not be a draft four.
book.surrogate.forms.title: Company Forms (Field Copy)
book.surrogate.forms.author: T. Marsh
book.surrogate.forms.page1:
FORM 7-C. NOTICE OF EXTENSION (VOLUNTARY).

I, the undersigned, volunteer for an extension of [   ] days. I understand that declining is a voluntary act with consequences.

Signed: ________
book.surrogate.forms.page2:
FORM 12-A. LOSS OF CHASSIS.

Chassis serial: ____
Cause: [ ] terrain [ ] pilot [ ] other
Estate to be billed: [ ] yes

In pencil, in the margin: they only print the one box.
book.surrogate.forms.page3:
FORM 3. REQUEST FOR SUPPLY.

Item: tomato seeds.
Reason: morale.
Status: DENIED. Seeds are not survey equipment.

Item: tomato seeds.
Reason: survey equipment.
Status: DENIED.
book.surrogate.forms.page4:
Back page, in pen:

Four chairs. One table. Ines says five.

The slab at Four is 7 by 9. Plates: 60. Glass: 12. Door: 1.

Do not let the company see this page.
terminal.surrogate.site02.name: SITE 02
terminal.surrogate.site02.1.title: OCCUPANT LOG
terminal.surrogate.site02.1.body:
# HALLORAN, ROTATION 2
Day 1: Pod sealed. Scrubber green. The annex chair is mine, the pod chair is for the next one.
Day 18: Marsh arrived on the supply run with a clipboard and no chassis. Says the company wants the numbers.
Day 40: Found a scrap heap south of the pad. Somebody walked out here before us and did not walk back.
Day 55: The annex scrubber coughs at night. Marsh says it is fine. Marsh says everything is fine.
Day 61: Sleeping in the chair. Easier than getting up.
terminal.surrogate.site02.2.title: THE NEW ONE
terminal.surrogate.site02.2.body:
# ROTATION 3, SITE 04
Day 209: They are landing the new pilot at Four. Six hundred metres. Marsh says it is about the survey grid. It is about the survey grid the way the extensions are voluntary.
Day 212: Drop tomorrow. Radio only for a while. I hate the radio. I will be good on the radio.
Day 213: Down. Answered the set on the first try, which is more than I did.
terminal.surrogate.site02.3.title: THE ROOM
terminal.surrogate.site02.3.body:
# COMMON ROOM, NOTES
Slab at Four is poured. Company will not ship the walls. We have sixty plates here and a pilot there with hands.

One table. Four chairs. Marsh says five, for the cat. Fine. Five.

When the assay is done and they stop calling, that is the first thing we build.
message.surrogate.dock_door.sealed: The collar door is sealed: nothing is docked.
tooltip.surrogate.crawler_kit: Use on level ground to assemble the hull
message.surrogate.crawler.no_room: No room to assemble the crawler here.
message.surrogate.crawler.hull_far: The hull is not answering. Give it a moment.
message.surrogate.crawler.helm: At the helm. Movement keys drive; sneak to step away.
message.surrogate.crawler.dock_seat: At the docking console. W backs the hull onto a collar; click to lock; S pulls away; sneak to step away.
message.surrogate.crawler.coupled_helm: Coupled to a collar. Uncouple from the docking console first.
message.surrogate.crawler.deployed: Chassis deployed beside the hull; the chair is keyed to it.
message.surrogate.crawler.bay_empty: The bay is empty. Use a chassis on it.

message.surrogate.crawler.use_bay: Not in here. The bay in the wall sends a chassis out beside the hull.
tooltip.surrogate.crawler_blueprint: The plans for a crawler hull, from Greenhouse Station
tooltip.surrogate.crawler_blueprint.use: Put it on the bench with the kit parts; it comes back
message.surrogate.port.needs_chassis: The port takes a chassis, not a person.
message.surrogate.survivor.blueprint: %s sends a file: CRAWLER BLUEPRINT. It is in your pack.
message.surrogate.crawler.lock_refused: Not on the collar. Line the ring up first.
terminal.surrogate.shelter_okafor.name: GREENHOUSE STATION
terminal.surrogate.shelter_okafor.1.body:
# GREENHOUSE STATION, CHASSIS PORT
One room, one scrubber, one researcher. Dr. Ada Okafor, soil and crop programme, contract 41.

A chassis on the port. That is the first thing on this line since the company stopped answering it.

Do not open the airlock. The room is clean and I would like it to stay that way. Talk here.
terminal.surrogate.shelter_okafor.2.body:
# SURROGATE SYSTEMS TRACKED HULL, MARK 2
My chassis is in three pieces in the porch and I have nothing to mend it with. So I cannot build this, and you can.

The file is on your chassis now. Hull plating round the outside, two servo motors, a block of iron in the middle, the blueprint on the bench with them. The bench gives the blueprint back.

Build it. Back it onto my collar, the door in the west wall. I will walk aboard. Then take me somewhere with a bed and something to eat, because this room is done.
terminal.surrogate.shelter_sorensen.name: SURVEY TWO
terminal.surrogate.shelter_sorensen.1.bo:
# SURVEY TWO, CHASSIS PORT
Mikkel Sorensen. Rover down, pod holding.

If you are reading this on a chassis, you are the first traffic on this port. The collar is on the west wall. Bring something with a ring on the back and I will get in it.
terminal.surrogate.shelter_tanaka.name: SULFUR WORKS
terminal.surrogate.shelter_tanaka.1.body:
# SULFUR WORKS, CHASSIS PORT
Yuki Tanaka. Cartridges spent, door lethal, mood fair.

The port is for talking. The collar on the west wall is for leaving. I would very much like to use the second one.
terminal.surrogate.shelter_brandt.name: BRANDT
terminal.surrogate.shelter_brandt.1.body:
# CHASSIS PORT
Brandt. Nobody asked for a port on this wall and here it is anyway.

Bread. And if you have one of those crawlers, the collar is on the west side. I am not walking anywhere.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.port.greet: A chassis on my port. Hello, tin can. Do not touch the airlock; talk here.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.port.blueprint: Listen. I have the plans for a crawler, a proper hull with a room in it, and no chassis to build it with. Mine is scrap. I am sending you the file. Build it, dock it here, and get me out.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.port.again: The blueprint is on your chassis. Hull plating, servos, an iron block, the plans on the bench. Then my collar, west wall.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.port.empty: Nobody home. She left on a crawler.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.aboard: I am in. I am in. Drive carefully, I have not been in a vehicle in two hundred days.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.home: A pod. With air in it. Show me the bed and I will tell you everything I know about tomatoes.
survivor.surrogate.okafor.home_radio: Greenhouse Station is closed. Okafor is at the pod. Somebody built a crawler, and it works.
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.port.greet: A chassis at the port. Copy. Mind the porch, it is where the rover died.
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.port.again: Still here. Still would like a lift.
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.port.empty: Nobody home. He left on a crawler.
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.aboard: Aboard. Nice hull. Who welded it?
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.home: Solid ground and a roof. I will earn my keep, I promise.
survivor.surrogate.sorensen.home_radio: Survey Two to all stations: Sorensen is at the pod. Somebody has a crawler out here.
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.port.greet: A chassis. On my port. I am going to stay very calm.
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.port.again: The collar is on the west wall. I checked it twice today.
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.port.empty: Nobody home. She left on a crawler.
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.aboard: In. Sealed. Breathing something that is not sulfur. Go.
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.home: This will do. This will do very well.
survivor.surrogate.tanaka.home_radio: Sulfur Works signing off for good. Tanaka is at the pod.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.port.greet: A tin can on the wall telling me there is a tin can at the wall. Fine. What.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.port.again: Bread. Or a crawler. Ideally both.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.port.empty: Nobody home. He left on a crawler, and complained the whole way.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.aboard: Right. I am in. It smells of new paint. Go on then.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.home: It has a kitchen. I will allow it.
survivor.surrogate.brandt.home_radio: Brandt. At the pod. Do not make a fuss.
message.surrogate.fabricator.started: Kit on the pad. Stand clear of the build site.
message.surrogate.fabricator.no_room: The ground ahead of the gantry is not clear.
message.surrogate.fabricator.idle: Idle. Put a vehicle kit on the pad.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.open1: Company representative, reading you the line I have to read. Sallow Assay, Contract Seven, stage one. The company has designated a site.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.open2: Designated it how? Nobody has been out there.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.open3: A survey satellite designated it. I have coordinates and a schedule and no reasons.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.open4: Right. Well. It is a long drive and the crawler is the only thing that will make it. Take the marker, take a charge, and I will talk you out.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.site1: That is the ground. Flat as a table and nobody has ever stood on it.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.site2: Site accepted. Stage one closed. Logging you as compliant, which is the nicest thing the form lets me say.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.site3: It is a pad, is what it is. They want to put something up. Get some plate down and we will find out what.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.pad1: Stage two. Landing platform, thirteen by thirteen, load-bearing. The company supplies nothing and expects it Thursday.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.pad2: The company supplies nothing, so we do. There is deck plating in the crate. Lay the middle out and leave the edges to me, they are fiddly.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.apron_done: That is a floor. Look at that. First flat thing on this planet somebody meant to be flat.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.apron_nudge: Plating from the crate, out across the middle. It does not have to be pretty.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.apron_timeout: You have got other things on. I will get a chassis over it. Do not tell Marsh it was not you.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.sorensen1: Survey Two to whoever is standing on that pad. I heard there was work. My rover is dead but my chassis walks.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.sorensen2: Sending it down with the legs and the frame. I have been carrying those since before you landed and I would rather they held something up.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.sorensen3: Mikkel Sorensen. Survey Two. He has been out here longer than any of us.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.sorensen4: Longer than I meant to be. Nice to build something for once instead of patching it.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.mast1: Mast, corner lights and a relay crate. That completes the company's contribution to the company's project.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.mast2: It went up, though. Look at it. That is a real thing on a real pad.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.gantry1: Last piece is mine. I have been keeping a fabricator gantry in a crate for four years waiting for a reason.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.gantry2: There. That will build anything you have the plans and the plate for. It is the best thing I own and it is standing on your pad.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.gantry3: Stage two closed. The form has a box for shared infrastructure and I have never ticked it before.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.core1: Stage three. The company requires a deep sample. Tellurium, three crystals, from below the deepslate line.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.core2: Below the what? Nobody has been below the deepslate line either.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.core3: The satellite says it is there. That is the whole of what I have.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.core4: Take the drill and take a spare cell. If the crawler radar picks up a pocket it will mark it. And come back up, I mean it, come back up.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.core_done: Three crystals logged. Stage three closed. That is the fastest anyone has closed a stage three.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.core5: It glows. Did you see that? Whatever they want it for, they want it badly enough to send a form about it.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.core_nudge: Three tellurium crystals, deep. The pockets are small and the caves have taken half of them.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.core_timeout: I sent a chassis down for the last one. Do not look at me like that, the schedule is not mine.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.payload1: Stage four. Assemble the sample vehicle at the gantry and load the capsule. Plans are in the relay crate.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.payload2: A rocket. They want a rocket. On my pad, with my gantry, made of our plate.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.payload3: Capsule is open. Everything we have logged goes up: the sulfur, the cinnabar, the salt, the lot.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.okafor1: Habitat Four to the pad. Grace Okafor. Is it true you have a gantry out there that works?
cinematic.surrogate.assay.okafor2: It is true. Grace has been running on one scrubber since spring.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.okafor3: Then I will say this once and then get off your channel: when the company's business is done, some of us out here would like a word about ours.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.payload4: Capsule sealed. Stage four closed. Stage five is ignition and then the contract is complete.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.rocket_nudge: Sample vehicle, at the gantry. Plate and plans, same as the crawler.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.load_nudge: Everything in the crate goes in the capsule. All of it.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.gather1: Everyone who can be here is here. Three chassis and nobody's lungs. Light it.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.ignite_nudge: The crystal goes in the core. That is the last thing anyone has to do for them.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.count1: IGNITION SEQUENCE ARMED. STAND CLEAR OF THE PAD.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.ship2: That is the ship. That is the company ship. It is here.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.after1: Payload received. Contract Seven is closed. The company thanks its personnel at Habitat Seven, Survey Two and Habitat Four for their contribution.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.after2: Marsh. Ask them when the ship comes down.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.after3: ...The ship was for the payload. There was never a second one. I am sorry. I did not know, and I should have.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.after4: Right. Everybody stay on this channel. We are going to work out how we get ourselves home, and we are going to start with the gantry we are standing next to.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.objective.driv: Drive to the company's designated site
cinematic.surrogate.assay.objective.apro: Lay deck plating across the pad
cinematic.surrogate.assay.objective.core: Bring three tellurium crystals to the pad crate
cinematic.surrogate.assay.objective.rock: Build the sample vehicle at the gantry
cinematic.surrogate.assay.objective.load: Load the capsule with the assay samples
cinematic.surrogate.assay.objective.igni: Ignite the rocket with a tellurium crystal
cinematic.surrogate.assay.drive_nudge: The site is a long way out. Take the crawler, and take your time.

message.surrogate.card_refused: %s is not yours to key. That chassis answers to someone else.
message.surrogate.not_yours: %s belongs to someone who is still using it.
message.surrogate.chassis_not_yours: No response. That chassis is answering to someone else.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.climb1: There it goes. Look at it go.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.climb2: ...How long until we know it made orbit?
cinematic.surrogate.assay.climb3: We do not. We are not on that channel. We just watch it get small.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.intercept1: MOVE. MOVE, GET DOWN, THAT IS COMING IN LOW
cinematic.surrogate.assay.intercept2: Payload retrieved. Contract Seven closed. The company thanks its personnel at Habitat Seven, Survey Two and Habitat Four for their contribution.
cinematic.surrogate.assay.intercept3: It did not even slow down.
